meta.title: Pixelpelula — Your team writes code fast. Why does shipping take weeks?
meta.description: Release Health Check: a 2-week diagnostic that measures where your delivery pipeline bleeds and hands you a 90-day plan. Numbers, not opinions.

hero.h1: Your AI writes code 3x faster. Your releases still take 6 weeks.
hero.sub: I fix the delivery bottleneck. The Release Health Check is a 2-week diagnostic that measures where your pipeline loses time — and hands you a 90-day plan. Numbers, not opinions.

problem.h2: Code got cheap. Shipping got expensive.
problem.text: In 2026, AI agents generate code faster than ever. But your team's bottleneck moved: review queues, flaky CI, release ceremonies, scary deploys. The result is a team that produces a lot and ships little — and a board asking why.

proof.h2: I've done this before. Three times.

cards.text: AI scale-up, Austria. Rebuilt the delivery and release process.
Full refactor with team reorganization, without stopping operations.
Delivery process for a multi-team programme in a high-regulation environment.

proof.closing: 25 years of engineering. Three different contexts. The same result: predictable releases.

offer.h2: Release Health Check — 2 weeks, fixed scope, fixed price.

items.text: deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR + rework rate. Measured from your data (Git, CI, tracker), not surveyed.
lead time per stage: where hours die between "ready" and "live".
each with evidence, monthly cost in €, and the recommended fix.
executable by the team you already have.
findings presented to the team. No blame, no endless slides.

offer.notIncluded: Not included: implementation. (If you want execution help afterwards, there's an advisory format — we talk after the diagnostic.)
offer.priceNote: founding rate for the first 3 clients; then €3,500

how.h2: Three steps. You barely see me.

steps.text: Read-only access to Git, CI and your tracker. My scripts measure everything. Your team doesn't stop.
A 7-minute team questionnaire (clicks only) + 3 short interviews with key people.
Within 2 weeks you get the report and the plan, presented to the team in 90 minutes.

about.text: I'm Teo Baiocco. 25 years in software engineering — developer, architect, tech lead, manager. I currently consult for European institutions through Pixelpelula. My job is finding where delivery gets stuck and unsticking it: not with a new tool, but with the right process for the team that exists. I don't sell promises; I sell track record.

faq.a: Yes, async-first. Only 2 synchronous calls (45-min kickoff + 90-min workshop).
Read-only: repository, CI logs, tracker export. No installation, no agent, no VPN.

faq.q: What if our data is a mess?
faq.a: That's a finding too — it goes in the report as an "observability gap", with a recommendation.
Teams looking for a hire disguised as consulting. I diagnose and plan; execution belongs to your team (or to advisory, later).

finalCta.h2: Your next release can be the first boring one.
